sensors.name: line tracker brightness in % (LINETRACKER, light mode)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the tracker reads below 70 % (black line), drive forward at 40 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; in a dark tunnel with no line, drive straight through without touching the walls; follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's brightness is below 70 % (it is on the black line)

branches.outcome: below 70 %, on black: it drives forward at 40 %
70 % or more, no black: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead in front

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine

branches.reason: followLine runs only when the tracker reads 70 % or more, which means no black line: this outcome only flickers at a line's edge and no test can set it up.

scenarios.coded_response: It drives straight forward at 40 % while it reads black; on a line that bends it leaves the line and then goes on to stopAtWall.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is on a black line, in bright light.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads below 70 % on the black line.
scenarios.title: Follows the black line
assumptions: You meant the robot steers along the line; the program only drives straight while it sees black.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line to its end.

scenarios.coded_response: It goes to stopAtWall, then to followLine, and with no black line it curves right on the floor and circles.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is inside a tunnel, with no black line under the line tracker.
scenarios.trigger: The tracker reads 70 % or more and no obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.title: Drives straight in the tunnel with no line
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight through the tunnel without touching its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is on the floor with no black line under it, and a wall is in front within the obstacle sensor's range.
scenarios.trigger: The obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall in front
assumptions: You didn't say what it should do at a wall; the program stops when one is ahead.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it.

uncertainties: Your light check reads the line tracker, not a light sensor: a black line reads as 'dark' (below 70 %) and the tunnel's dim light changes nothing it reads.
The program has no decision for the tunnel: inside it, with no black line, it curves right on the floor instead of driving straight.
It only drives straight while it sees black, so it doesn't steer along a line that bends.
After the tunnel it curves right on the floor and only finds the line again if it happens to cross it.
